data.body: Operator decision (2026-11-19 PST): option (1). This Mac (env 492a5c71) now signs with its own key, SHA256:va7mtsoMZ4fqriZ7lEH1dhnzwNJ+q9zbOBuWSKiuvUs (comment rebar-mac-492a5c71). It was added to identity 594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d by a KEY_ADD signed with the existing key oGCqzgfDMp. The Mac's REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY (signing.env and launchctl) now points at the new key, and ~/bin/refresh-rebar-signing-key.sh no longer points it back at the shared bot key. The review bot's clone keeps oGCqzgfDMp. This comment is the first event signed with the new key.
